name: Exp_GStop_Tm
summary: This EA is a trailing stop utility that applies a group-based trailing stop mechanism with time filtering capabilities. It manages existing positions by dynamically adjusting stop loss levels rather than opening new trades based on strategy signals. The 'GStop' refers to group stop management and 'Tm' indicates time-based operation windows.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个带时间过滤功能的分组跟踪止损工具，通过动态调整持仓的止损水平来管理现有仓位，而非根据策略信号开立新仓位。'GStop'指分组止损管理，'Tm'表示基于时间窗口的操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于工具类程序，不具备自主开仓的策略逻辑。其核心功能是对已有持仓进行分组跟踪止损管理，即根据价格变动动态调整止损位以锁定利润。时间过滤功能允许用户设定EA的活跃时段，仅在指定时间段内执行止损调整操作，避免在流动性较差或波动异常的时段进行管理。分组止损意味着可以将多个持仓作为一个组统一管理，当组内整体盈亏达到阈值时触发止损调整。仓位管理方面，EA不涉及开仓手数计算，仅管理已有仓位的止损移动。资金管理方面，通过跟踪止损间接保护资金，但本身不进行资金分配或风险预算。整体而言，这是一个辅助性的仓位管理工具，需配合其他开仓策略使用。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a utility-type program that does not possess autonomous trade-opening strategy logic. Its core function is group-based trailing stop management for existing positions, dynamically adjusting stop loss levels as price moves to lock in profits. The time filtering feature allows users to define active trading windows, restricting stop-loss adjustments to specified time periods to avoid operating during low-liquidity or abnormally volatile sessions. Group stop management means multiple positions can be managed collectively as a group, with stop adjustments triggered when the group's overall profit/loss reaches a threshold. In terms of position sizing, the EA does not calculate opening lot sizes since it only manages stop loss movements of existing positions. For money management, it indirectly protects capital through trailing stops but does not perform capital allocation or risk budgeting itself. Overall, this is an auxiliary position management tool that must be paired with another entry strategy EA.

parameters.name: ProfitTrailing
parameters.description: 是否仅在盈利时启用跟踪止损
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable trailing stop only when in profit

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 止损移动的最小步长（点数）
parameters.description_en: Minimum step for stop loss movement (points)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 魔术编号，用于标识要管理的持仓

parameters.name: GroupStop
parameters.description: 是否启用分组止损模式
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable group stop loss mode

pros: 跟踪止损能有效锁定浮盈，减少回撤风险
时间过滤功能避免在不利时段操作，提高管理效率
分组止损模式可统一管理多个相关持仓，简化操作
作为纯工具类EA，可与任意开仓策略配合使用，灵活性高
pros_en: Trailing stop effectively locks in floating profits and reduces drawdown risk
Time filtering avoids operations during unfavorable sessions, improving management efficiency
Group stop mode can uniformly manage multiple related positions, simplifying operations
As a pure utility EA, it can be paired with any entry strategy, offering high flexibility
cons: 无法自主开仓，必须依赖其他EA或手动交易先建立仓位
跟踪止损参数设置不当可能导致过早止损或保护不足
时间过滤若设置不当可能在重要行情时段错过止损调整
缺乏对滑点和延迟的考虑，极端行情下止损可能无法及时调整
cons_en: Cannot open positions autonomously; must rely on another EA or manual trading to establish positions first
Improper trailing stop parameter settings may lead to premature stops or insufficient protection
Poorly configured time filters may cause missed stop adjustments during important market moves
Lacks consideration for slippage and latency; stops may not adjust in time during extreme market conditions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态跟踪止损距离，适应市场波动性变化
添加盈亏比统计和可视化面板，方便用户监控管理效果
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop distance to adapt to changing market volatility
Add profit/loss ratio statistics and a visual dashboard for monitoring management effectiveness

risk_points: 跟踪止损参数设置过宽可能导致保护不足，过窄可能频繁触发止损
极端行情下（跳空、流动性枯竭），止损可能无法按预期水平执行
risk_points_en: Overly wide trailing stop parameters may provide insufficient protection, while overly narrow ones may trigger stops too frequently
Under extreme market conditions (gaps, liquidity drought), stops may not execute at expected levels
